gaze.rule: art/briefs/title-screen.md, The gaze: every sightline ends on the god's head or upper body

notes: Revision 6 (Leon, 9 Nov 2026: "first good one we got"): the squad small on the lip of a rock outcrop, every face turned up. The 16:9 frame at the safe rect's size, shifted 180 canvas px (5% of the screen) right into the overscan: there every sightline ends within 7-12 degrees of the god's face (at 1:1 they were 0-23 degrees left of it). The rock is mirrored into the right and bottom overscan; near-opaque alpha (245-254) is made opaque. Uniform resize, no sharpening.

glyph.source: apps/web/src/game/glyphs.ts (GLYPH_PATHS.ward and its class frame), SIGIL_INK #8BDEEE, SIGIL_GLOW #4FC8DF
glyph.edit: The generated render's made-up teal ring above the mage's hand (centre 1277.5, 548.5 in the native render, radius 20, and its stem) was cleared, the stem's foot on the fingertips softened (row 563 cleared, row 564 a soft edge in the skin colour below), and the WARD glyph drawn in its place: a white core line, the Sigil ink and glow, a soft halo, the class frame dimmer and thinner as in the game (55%), and a tapered thread of light from the fingertips to the shield's point, with a faint cyan rim on the fingertips; 46 px box in the native render, centred 3 px above the old ring.
